method: Run the two credentialed request functions from the lesson against local loopback redirect and target servers. First confirm the original default-urlopen behavior reaches the redirect target; then execute the lesson's post() and api_arm() functions and check that each stops on HTTP 302 without sending x-api-key to the target. Compile all lesson Python fences and rerun the existing selection-review verifier. No provider or external network calls.

observations.trace: Default redirect-following reproducer delivers the dummy x-api-key to the loopback target. Both post() and api_arm() then stop at HTTP 302; neither target receives a key.

limitations: This verifies the lesson's urllib behavior against local loopback servers, not an external API or provider.
It does not validate the configured base URL, TLS, proxies, credential provenance, or server-side redirect behavior in other HTTP clients.
Historical per-request provider responses remain missing; this does not reproduce the old API/UI comparison or test real UI/business side effects.
